text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian conquered the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). Having surpassed Oguri Cap, her 
next destination is the Japan Cup, the 
second leg of the Autumn Senior Triple 
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Around that time, news broke that Symboli 
Rudolf would be entering the Japan Cup. 
She intended to meet Narita Brian on the 
track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At last, she would face the "Emperor"... 
Narita Brian quietly revealed a fierce 
determination, thinking, "I will win"—
